map.实际 GDP 计算器，用 GDP 平减指数剔除价格变化得实际产出，用于经济增长真: A real GDP calculator that uses the GDP deflator to remove price changes and obtain real output, for genuine comparison of economic growth.
map.用 GDP 平减指数剔除价格变化，得到实际产出。: Use the GDP deflator to remove price changes and get real output.
map.实际产出：录入名义 GDP 与平减指数，算实际 GDP。: Real output: enter nominal GDP and the deflator to compute real GDP.
map.量价分离：对比名义与实际增速看价格贡献。: Separating volume from price: compare nominal and real growth to see the contribution of prices.
map.教学演示：演示通胀高时名义远超实际。: Teaching demo: shows how far the nominal figure exceeds the real one when inflation is high.
map.：示例：名义 GDP 110、平减指数 110，实际=110/(110/100): Example: nominal GDP 110, deflator 110, real = 110/(110/100) = 100, so there is no real growth.

map.GDP 平减指数=名义/实际×100，反映整体价格水平，区别于 CPI。结果仅作: GDP deflator = nominal / real x 100, reflecting the overall price level and distinct from CPI. map.实际 GDP 用于算真实增速，剔除了平减指数中的价格水分。结果仅作经济学教学与快: Real GDP is used to compute real growth, with the price component in the deflator stripped out. map.CPI 用于消费项、平减用于全 GDP，覆盖范围不同，勿混用。结果仅作经济学教学: CPI applies to consumer items while the deflator applies to total GDP; they cover different scopes and must not be mixed. Results are for economics teaching and quick estimation reference only, and do not constitute investment advice or a policy basis; for anything involving forecasts or empirical estimates, defer to authoritative statistics and textbooks.
